title: The Workshop Cabinet
question: Which padlock isn't keeping things shut?
rules_on_image: Drawers slide straight out; only the locks hold them shut.
No unlocking, damage or dismantling. The frame is fixed.

x_caption: A, B or C? Name the padlock that isn't doing its job—and explain why.

solution.explanation: B's hasp joins drawer 2 to drawer 3 and is not anchored to the fixed frame, so both drawers slide out together. A anchors drawer 1 to the frame top; C anchors drawer 4 to the frame bottom.
